about_the_game:
Critters' Breakout is a chaotic and fun 3D chase adventure set across a variety of explorable maps.

Experience the world from two different perspectives: play as one of the adorable Critters trying to escape, or take on the role of a ferocious Kollector determined to stop them.

The Critters aren’t just running for fun — one wrong move and they’re puppy chow!

To break free, they must search each map for useful items and build a secret gateway route to safety. Clever planning and quick thinking mean survival. Your goal as a Critter is to outsmart your pursuers and find a way to BREAKOUT!

The Kollectors have one purpose: shut down any hope of escape and bring an end to the Critters’ Breakout once and for all. Track, chase, and use unique abilities to CAPTURE the Critters before they manage to flee.

Along the journey, the Critters can rely on various friendly creatures to help them. The Mole Twins, the Filipino Tarsier, and others may lend a hand — feed them the right items and watch what happens.

The experience shifts between exploration and heart-pounding chase sequences. Every Critter and Kollector has their own characteristics, special abilities, and powers, letting you choose how you want to play.

Will you be the Hunter or the Hunted?

This is Critters’ Breakout!!

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS *: Windows Vista or greater
  • Processor: 2 GHz
  • Memory: 4 GB RAM
  • Graphics: 2 Gb video memory, shader model 3.0+
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Storage: 4 GB available space

short_description: Critters’ Breakout is a chaotic 3D chase adventure where you can play as the clever Critters escaping to freedom or as the fierce Kollectors trying to stop them. Scavenge items, outsmart enemies, and fight to survive. It is a Pinoy-made game that directly funds animal shelters when you play!
